summary: Two major defects found: part labels normalized from mixed Latin/Cyrillic to all-Cyrillic; table symbols in Problem 1 Part A converted from visual symbols to text descriptions.

defects.description: Part labels in Problem 1 use mixed Latin (A, B) and Cyrillic (В, Г, Д, Е) letters in the source, but candidate normalized to all-Cyrillic (А, Б, В, Г, Д, Е). Original page 2 shows 'A)' and 'B)' (Latin) while pages 3+ show Cyrillic.
defects.suggestedFix: Restore original mixed Latin/Cyrillic part labeling: A) Б) В) Г) Д) Е)

defects.description: Table in Problem 1 Part A contains visual symbol designations (oval, crossed-circle, diamond, ring) that mark different object types on the star map. Source shows these as actual visual symbols in the first column, but candidate transcribed them as text descriptions in parentheses: '(елипса/овал)', '(кръг с кръст)', '(четирилъчен ромб)', '(кръг/пръстен)'. This converts visual symbols to text representation.
defects.suggestedFix: Represent symbols more faithfully: use actual symbol characters/emoji or more accurate descriptions without parentheses, maintaining the table structure showing symbol in first column matching the objects labeled with those symbols on Figure 1.
